# Mexico Vital Records



[Mexico](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Genealogy "Mexico Genealogy")

Vital Records

Vital record information (such as birth, marriage, and death information) is recorded in Catholic Church records and civil registration records.

For help locating vital record information, see the links below.

## Birth Information

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| For births before 1867... | look through [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For births after 1867... | look first through [civil registration records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Civil_Registration "Mexico Civil Registration") then try [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For all birth, baptism, and christening | look through [Birth, Baptism, & Christening](https://www.ancestry.com/search/categories/bmd_birth/?event=_mexico&count=50&location=3255&priority=mexico&types=r&viewMode=category) on Ancestry.com |

## Marriage Information

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| For marriages before 1867... | look through [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For marriages after 1867... | look first through [civil registration records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Civil_Registration "Mexico Civil Registration") then try [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For marriages & divorce | look through [Marriage & Divorce](https://www.ancestry.com/search/categories/bmd_marriage/?event=_mexico&count=50&location=3255&priority=mexico&types=r&viewMode=category) on Ancestry.com |

## Death Information

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| For deaths before 1867... | look through [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For deaths after 1867... | look first through [civil registration records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Civil_Registration "Mexico Civil Registration") then try [Catholic Church records](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Mexico_Catholic_Church_Records_-_FamilySearch_Historical_Records "Mexico Catholic Church Records - FamilySearch Historical Records"). |
| For deaths, burial, cemetery, and obituaries in Mexico | look through [deaths, burial, cemetery, and obituaries](https://www.ancestry.com/search/categories/bmd_death/?event=_mexico&count=50&location=3255&priority=mexico&types=r&viewMode=category) on Ancestry.com |
